# LegalPDF Tools

Free client-side Bates stamping and permanent PDF redaction tool for legal professionals.

## Tools

- [Bates Stamp & Redact PDFs](/) - Main tool with live preview
- [Court Exhibit Bates Stamping](/bates-stamp-court-exhibits) - EXHIBIT-A- prefix, top-right, Times-Roman
- [Redact SSN & PII](/redact-ssn-from-pdf) - Auto-detect SSN, Aadhaar, emails
- [Discovery Production Bates](/bates-number-discovery-documents) - PROD- prefix, 7 digits
- [Confidential Stamps](/confidential-stamp-pdf) - CONFIDENTIAL- bottom-center
- [Financial Redaction](/redact-bank-account-numbers-pdf) - Account, routing, SWIFT keywords
- [HIPAA Medical Records](/medical-records-hipaa-pdf-redaction) - PHI Safe Harbor keywords
- [Paralegal Exhibit Generator](/law-firm-pdf-exhibit-generator) - Case prefixes, batch export

## API

- `POST /api/process-pdf` - Process PDF with Bates stamping and/or redaction
  - Accepts: multipart/form-data with PDF file
  - Returns: Processed PDF with applied stamps/redactions
  - Zero server retention - files processed in memory
